name: Engineering Computation & Numerical Methods
summary: Programming and numerical methods that mechanical engineers use daily to solve equations, fit data and simulate systems.

topics.name: Programming for engineers in Python or MATLAB: variables, control flow, functions
Arrays, vectorisation and plotting engineering data
Numerical error: round-off, truncation and Taylor series
Root finding: bisection, Newton's method and secant method
Linear systems: Gaussian elimination and LU decomposition
Curve fitting: least-squares regression and interpolation
Numerical solution of ODEs: Euler and Runge-Kutta methods
Handling test data: import, filtering and visualisation
